ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The left side of the figure is a regional schematic map, and the legend on the right shows that the dashed lines indicate annual precipitation lines, with the unit being mm; place Jia in the figure is located near a low-value annual precipitation line, and a precipitation label of about 100 mm can be seen around it, while an even lower 50 mm label can also be seen to the south, indicating that place Jia has little precipitation and an arid climate. Then reason: The question stem says that place Jia plants this jujube tree variety “according to local conditions”; agricultural production must adapt to the main local natural limiting factors. The main limiting factor in place Jia is insufficient water, so this jujube tree variety can be planted locally mainly because it can adapt to an arid environment, that is, it has drought-resistance characteristics.

method.method_draft: 先看图像：在图例中识别虚线为年降水量线，读出甲地附近的年降水量标注约为100～150 mm，说明甲地降水稀少、气候干旱。再读题干文字：甲地“因地制宜”种植该小枣品种，问该枣树适应当地环境的主要特性。关键桥梁是农业区位中的限制性因素原则：干旱地区发展作物，作物首先需要适应水分不足。因此答案应为耐旱。

再推理：题干说甲地“因地制宜”种植该品种枣树，农业生产要适应当地主要自然限制因素。甲地的主要限制因素是水分不足，因此该品种枣树能够在当地种植，主要是因为它能适应干旱环境，即具有耐旱特性。
